newsitem.title: ITALY: Cariplo outlines ideal banking partner.
newsitem.headline: Cariplo outlines ideal banking partner.

text.p: Milan-based savings bank Cariplo's ideal partner would be an Italian bank with a foreign presence, said the new chairman of the bank's foundation Giuseppe Guzzetti.
He was outlining the bank's ideal partner at a news conference as the bank prepares for privatisation. Guzzetti was named the chairman of the bank's controlling foundation earlier on Wednesday.
Asked about the bank's planned privatisation after two attempts had been cancelled, he said the process cannot be reversed and will go ahead in the next few months.
The outgoing chairman of the foundation Ottorino Beltrami added at the news conference that the 1996 results for Cariplo SpA were very good.
